query:
SELECT c.id, c.title, c."agentId", c."createdAt", c."updatedAt", 
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM messages m WHERE m."conversationId" = c.id) as message_count
FROM conversations c 
ORDER BY c."createdAt" DESC 
LIMIT 10;
